Description


	We are seeking a highly organised, detail-oriented, and analytical Farm Administrative Officer to support the effective administration and day-to-day operations of our farm.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate farm and employee records, coordinating administrative activities, preparing reports, supporting field operations, and providing reliable data and administrative information to the Farm Manager and Management.


Key Responsibilties


	Maintain accurate records of farm workers&#39; attendance, leave, overtime, and daily activities.
	Coordinate administrative activities at the farm and ensure proper documentation of farm operations.
	Collect, organise, and analyse farm and workforce data for management reporting.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly farm administrative reports.
	Maintain records of farm inputs, materials, equipment, fuel, tools, and other resources.
	Monitor and reconcile records relating to farm supplies and resource usage.
	Support the Farm Manager and supervisors with administrative and reporting requirements.
	Coordinate communication between farm management, field supervisors, workers, HR, and the head office.
	Maintain employee and farm documentation and ensure records are properly filed and updated.
	Monitor staff welfare, accommodation, transportation, and other administrative needs at the farm.
	Assist with procurement requests, logistics, inventory records, and general farm administration.
	Identify discrepancies or gaps in records and follow up with relevant supervisors for resolution.
	Maintain confidentiality and ensure the integrity of company and employee information.
	Support other administrative activities required for the smooth operation of the farm.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Accounting, Data Analytics, Agriculture, or a related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of relevant experience in administration, data analysis, farm administration, or a similar role.
	Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, charts, and data validation.
	Experience with data analysis and reporting will be an added advantage.
	Good organisational and record-keeping skills.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors or inconsistencies in data.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to prepare clear and accurate reports.
	Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with field workers and supervisors.
	Must be comfortable working in a farm/field environment.
	Willingness to work extended hours during critical farming activities when required.


Key Competencies:


	Administrative and organisational skills
	Data analysis and reporting
	Microsoft Excel proficiency
	Attention to detail
	Record keeping and documentation
	Problem-solving
	Communication and teamwork
	Integrity and confidentiality
	Ability to work in a fast-paced farm environment.


Salary
Very competitive.

Farm Administrative Officer Job at KannyVic Enterprise Consult




        
    

        
        KannyVic Enterprise Consult, a fast-growing agribusiness and climate-smart infrastructure company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position:  Farm Administrative Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking a highly organised, detail-oriented, and analytical Farm Administrative Officer to support the effective administration and day-to-day operations of our farm.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate farm and employee records, coordinating administrative activities, preparing reports, supporting field operations, and providing reliable data and administrative information to the Farm Manager and Management.


Key Responsibilties


	Maintain accurate records of farm workers' attendance, leave, overtime, and daily activities.
	Coordinate administrative activities at the farm and ensure proper documentation of farm operations.
	Collect, organise, and analyse farm and workforce data for management reporting.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly farm administrative reports.
	Maintain records of farm inputs, materials, equipment, fuel, tools, and other resources.
	Monitor and reconcile records relating to farm supplies and resource usage.
	Support the Farm Manager and supervisors with administrative and reporting requirements.
	Coordinate communication between farm management, field supervisors, workers, HR, and the head office.
	Maintain employee and farm documentation and ensure records are properly filed and updated.
	Monitor staff welfare, accommodation, transportation, and other administrative needs at the farm.
	Assist with procurement requests, logistics, inventory records, and general farm administration.
	Identify discrepancies or gaps in records and follow up with relevant supervisors for resolution.
	Maintain confidentiality and ensure the integrity of company and employee information.
	Support other administrative activities required for the smooth operation of the farm.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Accounting, Data Analytics, Agriculture, or a related field.
	2–4 years of relevant experience in administration, data analysis, farm administration, or a similar role.
	Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, charts, and data validation.
	Experience with data analysis and reporting will be an added advantage.
	Good organisational and record-keeping skills.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors or inconsistencies in data.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to prepare clear and accurate reports.
	Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with field workers and supervisors.
	Must be comfortable working in a farm/field environment.
	Willingness to work extended hours during critical farming activities when required.


Key Competencies:


	Administrative and organisational skills
	Data analysis and reporting
	Microsoft Excel proficiency
	Attention to detail
	Record keeping and documentation
	Problem-solving
	Communication and teamwork
	Integrity and confidentiality
	Ability to work in a fast-paced farm environment.


Salary
Very competitive.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

MEP Engineer Job at KannyVic Enterprise Consult




        
    

        
        KannyVic Enterprise Consult, a reputable and rapidly growing organization engaged in climate-smart agriculture, agroforestry, engineering, and sustainable land development, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: MEP Engineer

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT) and Delta (but will required to travel to different project sites)
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented MEP Engineer to join our growing team.
	In this role, you will be responsible for designing, coordinating, and overseeing the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems of our diverse building projects.
	The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between architectural vision and physical functionality, ensuring all systems are safe, efficient, and fully compliant with regulatory standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Design and engineer comprehensive HVAC, electrical distribution, lighting, plumbing, and fire protection systems.
	Create and refine detailed technical schematics, blueprints, and layouts using CAD and BIM software.
	Perform complex engineering calculations for heating/cooling loads, electrical circuitry, and hydraulic piping.
	Coordinate designs across architectural, structural, and civil teams to identify and resolve spatial clashes before construction.
	Conduct regular site visits to inspect installations, troubleshoot field issues, and ensure compliance with design specifications.
	Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, and equipment specifications to guarantee quality control.
	Ensure all system designs meet local building codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.


Required Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
	3 – 5 years of proven experience as an MEP Engineer or building services designer.
	Proficiency in engineering software, specifically AutoCAD and Autodesk Revit (BIM modeling).
	Strong working knowledge of local building codes, NFPA standards, and energy efficiency regulations.
	Excellent problem-solving abilities and a sharp eye for spatial coordination.
	Effective communication skills to collaborate cleanly with architects, contractors, and project stakeholders.


Salary
Very competitive inline with industry standard.

  "title": "Inventory Support Officer - POS Terminals",
  "description": "Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors&rsquo; first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Inventory Support Officer - POS Terminals

Job Location: Lagos

Role Purpose


	The ISO (Terminals) is the dedicated custodian for all forms of POS terminals flowing through the repair pipeline.
	The role ensures end-to-end traceability, enforces custody controls, and maintains absolute logical&ndash;physical alignment within the Repair Centre&#39;s IMS subsystem, covering every stage from receipt of faulty units to dispatch of QA-cleared OK devices.


Key Responsibilities
Intake &amp; Receipt Management:


	Receive faulty/returned terminals from state offices; verify against the recall waybill at serial-number level before accepting into the IMS.
	Log all received devices in the IMS with correct status within 24 hours of physical arrival.
	Identify and quarantine damaged or missing-serial devices; raise a Discrepancy Report immediately.


Repair Pipeline Tracking:


	Push faulty devices to technicians daily and update IMS status to &#39;In Repair&#39; upon assignment.
	Monitor movement of each terminal through all repair stages: Assessment &rarr; In Repair &rarr; Awaiting QA &rarr; QA Cleared &rarr; Dispatch Holding.
	Enforce the 24&ndash;72-hour SLA from receipt-to-assignment and from QA clearance-to-dispatch readiness.


QA Integration &amp; Status Management:


	Receive QA-approved terminals and update IMS status to &#39;QA Cleared &ndash; Awaiting Dispatch&#39; within 4 hours.
	Flag devices that fail QA back to the repair queue or classify as &#39;Beyond Economic Repair (BER)&#39; with a written justification report.
	Ensure all &#39;BER&#39; devices are tagged and isolated in the scrap/disposal holding area.


Dispatch &amp; Outbound Logistics:


	Generate the Dispatch List and Waybill for QA-cleared refurbished and OK devices; obtain approval from Repair Centre Manager and Cluster lead before release.
	Scan all devices at serial level during physical loading; update IMS to &#39;In Transit &ndash; Outbound&#39;.
	Confirm receipt acknowledgment from the destination state SIO and close the dispatch transaction in IMS.


Inventory Counts &amp; Reconciliation:


	Conduct daily physical counts of all terminals in the repair centre; reconcile against IMS records.
	Escalate any variance (physical vs. logical) to the Lead, Inventory Support within the same business day.
	Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual wall-to-wall counts as directed by the Inventory &amp; Warehouse Manager.


Compliance &amp; Housekeeping:


	Maintain clearly labelled racks and segregated zones: Faulty, Under-Repair, Refurbished/OK, BER/Scrap.
	Enforce all provisions of the POS Inventory Control SOP within the repair centre.
	Uphold audit readiness, workplace safety, and environmental handling standards at all times.


Requirements&nbsp;


	Minimum of OND in a related discipline&nbsp;
	At least 2 years of experience in inventory operations.
	Good computer skills. Must know the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint)&nbsp;
	Ability to work with limited supervision.&nbsp;
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Proficiency in inventory management systems and workflow applications.
	Experience handling large volumes of items&nbsp;
	Excellent organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Effective communication and stakeholder coordination.
	Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


Reporting Line:


	Functional: Lead, Inventory Support (Regional)
	Operational: Repair Centre Manager
	Dotted: Regional Inventory &amp; Warehouse Manager.

Inventory Support Officer - POS Terminals Job at Moniepoint




        
    

        
        Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors’ first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Inventory Support Officer - POS Terminals

Job Location: Lagos

Role Purpose
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The ISO (Terminals) is the dedicated custodian for all forms of POS terminals flowing through the repair pipeline.
	The role ensures end-to-end traceability, enforces custody controls, and maintains absolute logical–physical alignment within the Repair Centre's IMS subsystem, covering every stage from receipt of faulty units to dispatch of QA-cleared OK devices.


Key Responsibilities
Intake & Receipt Management:


	Receive faulty/returned terminals from state offices; verify against the recall waybill at serial-number level before accepting into the IMS.
	Log all received devices in the IMS with correct status within 24 hours of physical arrival.
	Identify and quarantine damaged or missing-serial devices; raise a Discrepancy Report immediately.


Repair Pipeline Tracking:


	Push faulty devices to technicians daily and update IMS status to 'In Repair' upon assignment.
	Monitor movement of each terminal through all repair stages: Assessment → In Repair → Awaiting QA → QA Cleared → Dispatch Holding.
	Enforce the 24–72-hour SLA from receipt-to-assignment and from QA clearance-to-dispatch readiness.


QA Integration & Status Management:


	Receive QA-approved terminals and update IMS status to 'QA Cleared – Awaiting Dispatch' within 4 hours.
	Flag devices that fail QA back to the repair queue or classify as 'Beyond Economic Repair (BER)' with a written justification report.
	Ensure all 'BER' devices are tagged and isolated in the scrap/disposal holding area.


Dispatch & Outbound Logistics:


	Generate the Dispatch List and Waybill for QA-cleared refurbished and OK devices; obtain approval from Repair Centre Manager and Cluster lead before release.
	Scan all devices at serial level during physical loading; update IMS to 'In Transit – Outbound'.
	Confirm receipt acknowledgment from the destination state SIO and close the dispatch transaction in IMS.


Inventory Counts & Reconciliation:


	Conduct daily physical counts of all terminals in the repair centre; reconcile against IMS records.
	Escalate any variance (physical vs. logical) to the Lead, Inventory Support within the same business day.
	Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual wall-to-wall counts as directed by the Inventory & Warehouse Manager.


Compliance & Housekeeping:


	Maintain clearly labelled racks and segregated zones: Faulty, Under-Repair, Refurbished/OK, BER/Scrap.
	Enforce all provisions of the POS Inventory Control SOP within the repair centre.
	Uphold audit readiness, workplace safety, and environmental handling standards at all times.


Requirements 


	Minimum of OND in a related discipline 
	At least 2 years of experience in inventory operations.
	Good computer skills. Must know the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) 
	Ability to work with limited supervision. 
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Proficiency in inventory management systems and workflow applications.
	Experience handling large volumes of items 
	Excellent organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Effective communication and stakeholder coordination.
	Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


Reporting Line:


	Functional: Lead, Inventory Support (Regional)
	Operational: Repair Centre Manager
	Dotted: Regional Inventory & Warehouse Manager.
